test_title: PYST 10 - SSC CHSL 2025 - English Language (Held On: 15 Nov, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
**Fill in the blank with the most appropriate conjunction:**

"He has a lot of potential, ______ his lack of discipline may hinder his growth."
solution:
The correct answer is '**whereas**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The conjunction "**whereas**" is used to show contrast between two clauses.
 
• In the given sentence, the two parts are contrasting: "He has a lot of potential" contrasts with "his lack of discipline may hinder his growth."
 
• **Options 2, 3, 4**, and 5 are grammatically incorrect or do not fit the context of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Complete Sentence:** *"He has a lot of potential, **whereas**__ his lack of discipline may hinder his growth."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2: "unless"** is incorrect because it is used to introduce a condition, not a contrast.
 
• **Option 3: "because"** is incorrect as it introduces a reason, not a contrasting idea.
 
• **Option 4: "albeit"** is incorrect because it means "although" or "even though," and does not fit with the structure of the sentence.
